title: agent 的上下文管理，從零講起——Slack 為什麼不傳訊息歷史
summary: Slack 安全工程的 agent 設計：完全不在 agent 之間傳 message history，三個共享資源（Director's Journal、Critic's Review、Critic's Timeline）取代訊息歷史。
widget_questions: Across five candidate context strategies, which trade-offs make each one fit a different shape of agent workload?
Which role (Director / Expert / Critic) owns which responsibility, and which structured resource (Journal / Review / Timeline) does each one read versus write?
What is the actual shape of the credibility distribution across 170,000+ reviewed findings, and how does the 0.5 threshold partition trustworthy from dropped?
How does prompt-token cost grow with investigation length under naive message-history vs three-resource designs, and when does each hit the 200K context window?
